description: Combined EMA240 trend + VWAP drift + logret_ema/sigma Z-score decision model. Always returns Bull or Bear (no Neutral). Uses hierarchical agreement logic with drift-override when |Z| >= z_strong (0.30).

equation_logic.case_1_full_agreement: If E_dir = V_dir = Z_dir → Trend = E_dir
equation_logic.case_2_ema_vwap_agree: If E_dir = V_dir != Z_dir → Trend = E_dir
equation_logic.case_3_ema_z_agree: If E_dir = Z_dir != V_dir → Trend = E_dir

notes: VWAP drift (V_dir) captures medium-horizon trend alignment.
When VWAP and Z agree against EMA and |Z| >= 0.30 → treat as an early flip.
When VWAP and Z agree but |Z| < 0.30 → keep EMA direction.
